snippet.title: A Teacher Tied 13 Kids Together and Led Them Through a Blizzard #BlizzardOf1888 #Shorts
snippet.description:
When a Nebraska school began coming apart in the 1888 blizzard, Minnie Freeman tied thirteen pupils together with twine and led them toward a farmhouse three-quarters of a mile away. Carrying the youngest, she brought all thirteen to safety.
